observations: Photo 0 shows a promotional image of a DTF printer and oven setup with branding 'Yinghe' and text 'A2 DTF PRINTER + OVEN'.
The setup includes a large flatbed printer on top and a black box-like curing oven below, with a powder shaker and ink system implied.
Photo 1 shows a similar setup from a side angle, with visible control panel, fans, and branding 'Yinghe' on the printer and oven.
Photo 2 shows the same setup in a real indoor environment with tiled floor and wall, confirming physical presence.
All photos have a watermark 'MYCODE TECHNOLOGIES LTD' and 'POSTED ON JIJI', suggesting a listing from a Nigerian marketplace.
The printer is labeled as A2 size (420mm) and uses Epson 12200 print head (claimed in photo 0).
No visible serial numbers, power cords, or operational status indicators in any photo.

Claimed in photo 0 text, but no close-up of print head is visible in any photo. Cannot verify without a shot of the print head.

response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Yinghe A2 DTF printer and oven setup, but critical claims about completeness, print head model, and functionality cannot be verified from current photos. Hidden risks include missing components and non-functionality, which would significantly affect price. Proof is required before pricing.
